root_cause.description: The v9 runner reused prelim75.gpu_setup(), which sets torch.backends.cudnn.allow_tf32=false, while the archived L1 package was produced by the generic inference entry in a clean process with cudnn.allow_tf32=true.

recovery_rule: Preserve the failed output, make the archived generic inference CUDA numerics explicit, then rerun smoke, diagnostic, and full replay. All failed and recovery GPU actions count toward the same 7200-second cap.
